biggest_catch: Amazon pays commissions only on qualifying purchases — there are zero guaranteed sales, campaigns, or earnings, and rates vary by product category.
catches: ZERO GUARANTEED EARNINGS: you earn only when a shopper makes a qualifying purchase through your storefront, links, or shoppable content — no guaranteed income, campaigns, or flat fees from Amazon itself.
BRAND-SELECTION RISK: paid brand collaborations go through Creator Connections, a marketplace where brands choose creators; brand deals are at the brand's discretion and are not guaranteed.
VARIABLE PAY: Amazon states creators 'receive a standard commission on qualifying purchases, with rates varying by product category' — no fixed per-creator rate is published on the official page.

CONTENT RIGHTS: shoppable photos and videos you upload 'is then eligible to appear across Amazon, including product detail pages, search results, and the homepage' — your content may be displayed across Amazon's surfaces per the program terms.
Application is competitive: Amazon evaluates applicants on content quality, engagement rate, and follower count; not everyone who applies is accepted.

c1.evidence: Amazon — official program; terms confirmed on Amazon's own news site (aboutamazon.com), with signup on Amazon's affiliate domain (affiliate-program.amazon.com).

c2.evidence: Official Amazon article 'How to join the Amazon Influencer Program and earn money' describes the commission mechanics for creators in detail.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee stated anywhere on the official page; the program is free to join.

c4.evidence: Official: 'Creators receive a standard commission on qualifying purchases, with rates varying by product category.'

eligibility: Creators with a qualifying YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, or Facebook account. Amazon evaluates applicants on content quality, engagement rate, and follower count. Available in 20+ countries including the U.S.
notes: Commission mechanics verified verbatim from Amazon's official article on 2026-09-22. The program is an extension of Amazon's affiliate network (Associates), so per-category commission rates follow the Associates rate card — the official article confirms rates vary by category but does not print the rate card itself. Payout timing is not stated on the official article; Associates-basis payout terms apply. App links left null rather than guessed.

s1.note: Qualifying social account required (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, or Facebook); Amazon judges content quality, engagement, and follower count — acceptance is not automatic.

s2.note: No enrollment fee; earnings are purely performance-based commissions on qualifying purchases; brand deals via Creator Connections are brand-selected.

s3.note: No payout schedule stated on the official article — commissions accrue on qualifying purchases and are paid under Amazon Associates payout terms.

s4.note: No weasel words on the core mechanic — commission on qualifying purchases, category-variable rates, and multiple earning models stated flatly.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: apply with a qualifying social account, build your storefront and idea lists, create shoppable content, share referral links, earn commissions on qualifying purchases.

steps: Apply to the Amazon Influencer Program online at https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/influencers using a qualifying TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, or Facebook account.
Once approved, build your personalized Amazon storefront (amazon.com/shop/yourhandle) and organize recommendations into themed Idea Lists.
Add products to your storefront via search or direct ASIN entry; create shoppable photos and videos, which are eligible to appear across Amazon's product detail pages, search results, and homepage.
Share your storefront URL and personalized referral links with your followers on social media.
Earn a standard commission on qualifying purchases made through your storefront, links, or shoppable content — commissions are not limited to the specific product you recommended.
Optionally use Creator Connections to pitch for brand collaborations (bonus commissions, traffic payments, or flat-rate sponsored content fees) — brand-selected, not guaranteed.
Creator Rewards can add a monthly bonus on top of standard commissions when you hit certain sales targets.
timing: No payout schedule stated on the official Amazon article. Commissions accrue on qualifying purchases; payouts are made under Amazon Associates payout terms (confirm the current Associates fee schedule).
